name: mujoco_inverted_pendulum_v5_wall_clock
description: InvertedPendulum-v5 cart-pendulum benchmark with a fixed wall-clock training window.
notes: Use this benchmark when comparing cart-pendulum training recipes under equal wall-clock time.
train_episodes is a high safety cap; train_seconds is the intended budget.
This task can saturate quickly; prefer short wall-clock runs for smoke and recipe debugging.
